summary: String decoder that expands '+~XX' hex-escape sequences while copying all other characters verbatim into an output buffer with a hard length cap. Null input or output pointer returns 0 immediately. The output buffer is reset to an empty string first, then a '+'-prefixed escape is recognized only when at least 4 input bytes remain, the following byte is '~' (126), and the two bytes after it are both valid hex digits; the two hex digits are parsed via StrlenFormatCallWrapper with a '%x' format and the decoded byte is appended. Every append is guarded by a buffer-overflow check against limit a3. Returns 1 on full decode of the input, 0 on null input or overflow. Called from file/path/player-name handling paths.

local_names.a2: output buffer filled by decoded characters
local_names.v12: parsed hex byte value from the '%x' format call
local_names.v18: single decoded byte plus null terminator ready for append
